description: Angular component for managing a list of entity types with autocomplete and form controls, used in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: EntityTypeListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting and displaying a list of entity types with autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on the 'required' input.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets placeholders, and prepares entity type list.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value from external source.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an entity type to the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity type from the list.

methods.name: displayEntityTypeFn
methods.description: Returns display string for an entity type.

methods.name: fetchEntityTypes
methods.description: Fetches filtered list of entity types based on search text.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and refocuses.
